info.title: dotnet-redecker
info.description:
An update tool for .NET dependencies that reads packages rather than just their version
      graph, and treats the reason a pin exists as machine-readable data.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Inspect and update .NET dependencies with knowledge of how NuGet packages are built.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Check a package version for problems that restore cannot see.

options.name: --to
options.description: The version being considered. Required unless --file is given.

options.name: --from
options.description: The version currently referenced. Enables upgrade-only checks.

options.name: --source
options.description: NuGet V3 flat container base URL. [default: https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer]

options.name: --file
options.description: Inspect a .nupkg on disk instead of downloading one. Identity is read from the nuspec inside. Use this to check a package before publishing it.

arguments.name: PACKAGE
arguments.description: Package identifier to inspect. Omit when using --file.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Check the versions a repository declares for coherence. Runs offline unless --online.

options.name: --online
options.description: Also check constraints that declared packages place on each other, which requires reading their nuspecs from nuget.org. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: A project file, Directory.Packages.props, or a directory containing one. [default: .]

commands.name: hints
commands.description: List pin rationales and check whether they still apply.

options.name: --check
options.description: Re-evaluate exit conditions; exits non-zero if any pin can be retired. [default: False]

options.name: --source
options.description: NuGet V3 flat container base URL. [default: https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer]

options.name: --github-token
options.description: GitHub token used by issue-blocker conditions. Defaults to $GITHUB_TOKEN. Without one GitHub allows only 60 requests an hour.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: A project file, Directory.Packages.props, or a directory containing one. [default: .]
